resources.string:
0.14.4
- Added a new tile view for categories.
- Added German and Belarusian language support.
- Improved the initial app setup.
- Fixed bugs and improved stability.

0.14.3
- Updated category icons.
- Improved app functionality.
- Redesigned the Settings screen.
- Improved app stability and appearance.

0.14.2
- Added recently and frequently used categories.
- Categories are now easier to select and customize.
- Improved transfers between your own accounts.
- Added quick periods for the journal and reports: week, month, last 30 days, and more.
- Date filtering is now more accurate.
- Fixed bugs and improved stability.

0.14.1
- The Russian version of the app was renamed to “Учёт финансов” due to a potential copyright issue.
- Favorite categories have been added.
- The interface has been improved.
- Stability has been improved.

0.14.0
- Updated Reports with a new design, chart, and category breakdown.
- Improved category selection in Reports.
- Added a new category group: Subscriptions & Online Services.
- Fixed bugs and improved stability.

0.13.3
- Fixed language selection during first app setup.
- Fixed default accounts with localized names.
- Added a new default income category: sick leave payments.
- Improved first-launch stability and existing data updates.

0.13.2
- Fixed issues with restoring screens and backups.
- Added new default icons for categories.
- Improved app stability.

0.13.1
- Updated the app icon.
- Added icons for starter categories and parent categories.
- Added a Journal setting for how parent categories are shown.
- Expanded the category icon set.
- Fixed navigation on the transfer screen.
- Fixed restoring fresh database backups after updates.
- Fixed some issues and improved stability.
List of changes
Version history

0.13.0
- Added Polish localization.
- Polish can now be selected on first launch and in Settings.
- Added Polish names for standard categories and dictionaries.
- Transfers between accounts now have a separate screen.
- Improved transfers between accounts in different currencies.
- Fixed navigation between the Transfer screen and other menu items.
- Added date separators in the Journal.

0.12.1
- Added Polish language support in first launch and Settings.
- Standard categories can now show Polish names after update.
- Improved the interface and currency experience.
- Added a Journal setting for currency display.
- Added neat date separators in the Journal, with today, yesterday, and older dates shown clearly.
- Fixed minor issues and improved stability.

0.12.0
- Updated the app theme.
- Added a Personal Care starter category group.
- Fixed minor interface and stability issues.

0.11.0
- Added app language switching.
- Added English localization.
- First launch is simpler with setup modes.
- Added a Personal Care starter category group.
- Currencies can now be added from the catalog.
- Journal totals are now shown by currency.
- Bug fixes and stability improvements.

0.10.2
- English is now the default app language, with Russian available in Settings.
- First launch now starts with a language choice and applies it before the rest of setup.
- Default accounts, categories, reports, payments, and quick payments can show localized names from the database.
- Existing Russian first-launch text was restored to normal UTF-8.
- First launch was improved: category and currency setup is now simpler.
- New users can choose starter category groups.

0.10.1
- Parent category sorting was fixed: parent categories can now be dragged freely through the list.
- Quick access panel settings were added: choose 3 to 5 bottom navigation buttons and keep Settings close at hand.
- New installations now start with Payments, Categories, Journal, and Settings in the bottom panel.
- First launch now guides new users to Categories and shows a Journal hint for creating the first entry.
- Categories can now start a custom payment immediately: tap a category to open the payment screen with it already selected.

0.10.0
- Added transfers between your own accounts.
- Updated first launch: choose currencies, accounts, defaults, and the start screen.
- Settings are now collected on one screen.
- Added quick payment settings and faster currency/account selection.
- Updated the calculator and amount entry.
- Improved journal, category, currency, and account screens.
- Fixed keyboard, filters, updates, backups, and zero-amount confirmation.
- Thank you for using the app. May tracking money feel calmer, clearer, and a little easier every day.

0.9.10
- Settings are now collected on one screen.
- Added startup section selection and default currency/account setup.
- Added transfers between your own accounts.
- Improved first-launch currency setup and payment entry.
- Refreshed category dialogs, input fields, buttons, and the payment calculator.
0.9.9\n- Fixed several category screen glitches: list items no longer overlap while scrolling, category search is opened from the toolbar, and parent category names wrap more cleanly.
0.9.8\n- Fixed issues that could cause icons to change after an application update.\n- Added encrypted backup and restore for transferring data between phones.

0.9.7
- Added the option to select multiple currencies on first launch.
- Added quick category search.
- Added quick selection of currencies, categories, and accounts.
- Added a calculator when entering a payment.
0.9.6.1\n- Fixed a bug with the button to add a new quick payment.\n- Fixed a bug with a pop-up window in the log.

0.9.6
- When making a payment, a pop-up window appears to quickly add the next payment.
- Added a button to clear the amount when making a payment.
- Only vertical orientation has been added.
- Some interface bugs have been fixed.
0.9.5\n- Improvements in the work of fast payments, namely, by short pressing on a fast payment, it is made immediately, by long pressing the settings dialog box appears.\n- Fixed some bugs.
0.9.3\n- More icons added.\n- Fixed display errors in some windows.
0.9.2\n- Icons have been added to the category.\n- Added List Of changes message, after update the application.
0.9.1.1\n- Fixed some bugs in reports.
0.9.1\n- Added sorting in quick payments.
0.9.0\n- Added quick payments.
0.8.8.2\n- Some improvements in the interface.
0.8.8.1\n- Ability to select a time period in reports.
0.8.8.0\n- Fixed some bugs in reports.
